title: QUIZ - 74
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Write a function rule modeling a real-world fixed-fee-plus-rate scenario
questions.question: A rental company charges a $27 base fee plus $17 per day (x). Write a function f(x) for the total rental cost.
questions.explanation: The per-day rate (17) multiplies the number of days x, and the fixed fee (27) is added once: f(x) = 17x + 27.
questions.hint: Multiply the rate by the variable, then add any fixed, one-time cost.

questions.concept: Writing Quadratic Function Rules from Descriptions
questions.learningObjective: Translate a multi-step verbal description into a quadratic function rule
questions.question: A function f squares the input t, multiplies the result by 2, adds 5 times the input, then adds -9. Write the function rule.
questions.explanation: Squaring the input gives t^2; multiplying by 2 gives 2t^2. Adding 5 times the input gives 5t. Adding -9 gives the full rule.
questions.hint: Translate each described step in order: square first, then apply the multiplier, then add each additional term.

questions.question: A function h squares the input n, multiplies the result by 3, adds 9 times the input, then adds -14. Write the function rule.
questions.explanation: Squaring the input gives n^2; multiplying by 3 gives 3n^2. Adding 9 times the input gives 9n. Adding -14 gives the full rule.

questions.learningObjective: Translate a verbal description of a sequence of operations into function notation
questions.question: A function h takes an input x, multiplies it by 5, then adds 4. Write the function rule.
questions.explanation: Multiplying the input by 5 gives 5x; adding 4 afterward gives the rule shown in the correct option.
questions.hint: Translate each operation in the order described, applying it to the input variable.
